questions.q: Tell me about your work in Tally. What kind of company was it, and which vouchers, reports or GST tasks did you handle yourself?
questions.looks_for: Real business, names voucher types (sales, purchase, payment, receipt, journal), reports like GSTR data or ledgers, and their own regular duties.

questions.q: Describe a GST-related problem you handled, such as a mismatch in input credit or a wrong invoice. What did you do?
questions.looks_for: Specific case: found mismatch with GSTR-2B or wrong GSTIN/tax rate, contacted vendor or corrected entry, explains the outcome.

questions.q: What is input tax credit, and when can a business not claim it even if it paid GST on a purchase?
questions.looks_for: Credit of GST paid on purchases against output tax; blocked or lost when vendor has not filed or not shown in 2B, no valid invoice, goods not received, or blocked items like personal use.

questions.q: When do you charge CGST and SGST, and when do you charge IGST on a sale?
questions.looks_for: CGST+SGST for sale within the same state, IGST for sale to another state or import/export; place of supply decides.

questions.q: In Tally, how do you set up a new party ledger and stock item so that GST comes correctly on invoices?
questions.looks_for: Correct group (sundry debtor/creditor), GSTIN and state, registration type; stock item with HSN and GST rate; then check the invoice tax lines.

questions.q: A vendor's invoice of last month is not showing in your GSTR-2B, and your manager wants to claim the credit anyway. What would you do?
questions.looks_for: Explains the credit may not be allowed, contacts vendor to file or correct, keeps the bill on hold, tells the manager the risk politely, follows rules.

questions.q: Why do you want this Tally and GST accounts job, when can you join (state your notice period), and what salary do you expect?
questions.looks_for: Clear reason linked to the work, states notice period or joining date in days or weeks, and gives an expected monthly or yearly salary figure or range without dodging.
